# Municipal Ordinance No. KauPamBayanBlg03S1994, Series of 1994

**Kau.PamBayan Blg. 03**

## Summary

Municipal Ordinance (Kautusang Pambayan) No. 03, Series of [[1994]], enacted by the [[Sangguniang Bayan]] of [[Municipality of Pitogo|Pitogo]], Quezon on October 31, 1994. This ordinance establishes regulations governing the cutting of coconut trees (puno ng niyog) within the municipality. It was enacted in response to the indiscriminate harvesting of coconut trees that was depleting the town's primary agricultural resource, and it requires permits and imposes penalties on violators.

## Key Provisions

- **Resolution (Kapasiyahan Blg. 204):** The [[Sangguniang Bayan]] resolves to enact regulations on the cutting of coconut trees, citing that coconut is the primary product of Pitogo, that indiscriminate cutting causes significant economic damage, that it adversely affects the livelihood and welfare of residents, and that unchecked cutting could lead to reduced tax collection.
- **Section I.** No person shall be allowed to cut coconut trees within the scope of the existing law or applicable rules. Any coconut tree to be cut must first be reported to the Punong Barangay (Barangay Captain).
- **Section II.** No person shall be allowed to cut coconut trees on land they are cultivating or occupying unless the owner of the coconut trees planted on such land has given written consent from the Punong Barangay.
- **Section III.** No person shall be allowed to cut coconut trees without the required clearance from the Punong Barangay (Barangay Captain), specifically:
  - (a) No cutting within a five-year moratorium on trees planted during the current term.
  - (b) Other conditions as required.
- **Section IV.** Any person seeking to cut coconut trees must first obtain a Mayor's Permit from the Punong Bayan (Municipal Mayor).
- **Section V.** Violators of this ordinance shall be fined Two Thousand Five Hundred Pesos (P2,500.00) and subjected to penalties as provided by law.
- **Section VI.** All provisions of this ordinance not in conflict with existing laws shall remain in effect.
- **Section VII.** This ordinance shall take effect upon approval by the appropriate authorities.

**Penalties:** Fine of P2,500.00 for violations.
